concepts.title: Closure of finite Blaschke products under composition
concepts.description: The composition of two nonconstant finite Blaschke products of degrees m and n is a finite Blaschke product of degree mn; composing with a disk automorphism preserves the degree.

concepts.title: Finite Blaschke product
concepts.description: A function B(z)=c∏ₖ₌₁ⁿ(z−aₖ)/(1−āₖz), with |c|=1 and |aₖ|<1. Constant unimodular functions are allowed when n=0.

concepts.title: Finitely supported scalar sequence
concepts.description: A scalar sequence with only finitely many nonzero terms; these sequences form the vector space c₀₀.

concepts.title: Surface-area integral formula for first mixed volume
concepts.description: For full-dimensional convex bodies K,L⊂ℝⁿ, V(K[n−1],L)=n⁻¹∫_{S^{n−1}}h_L(u)dS_K(u).

concepts.title: Florentin–Segal quantitative symmetrization theorem for star-shaped sets
concepts.description: For n≥2, 0<ε<1/2 and a nonempty compact set K⊂ℝⁿ star shaped about 0, at most Cn|log ε| Minkowski symmetrizations produce K̃ with (1−ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ⊆K̃⊆(1+ε)M*(K)B₂ⁿ, for a universal C.

concepts.title: Formal L² adjoint of a differential operator on a surface
concepts.description: For a differential operator D between Euclidean vector-valued functions on a smooth surface, its formal adjoint D* is specified by ∫⟨Du,v⟩=∫⟨u,D*v⟩ for smooth compactly supported test fields, using the induced surface measure. This identity does not assert a bounded operator on L².

concepts.title: Fourier inversion theorem on Schwartz space
concepts.description: With f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e^{−ix·ξ}dx, every Schwartz function satisfies f(x)=(2π)^{−n}∫f̂(ξ)e^{ix·ξ}dξ, and the Fourier transform maps Schwartz space continuously onto itself.

concepts.title: Fourier transform on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For an integrable f on ℝⁿ, its Fourier transform is f̂(ξ)=∫f(x)e⁻ⁱˣ·ξ dx; extend it to Schwartz functions and tempered distributions by duality.

concepts.title: Frazier–Jawerth φ-transform
concepts.description: A discrete analysis map sends a tempered distribution to its scale-normalized convolutions with admissible band-limited Schwartz functions sampled at dyadic cube corners; a dual family reconstructs it by summing the associated atoms.

concepts.title: Fréchet derivative between normed spaces
concepts.description: The Fréchet derivative of f at x is a bounded linear map A with ∥f(x+h)−f(x)−Ah∥/∥h∥→0 as h→0.

concepts.title: Frobenius norm of a real or complex matrix
concepts.description: The Frobenius norm of A is (∑_{i,j}|a_{ij}|²)^{1/2}.

concepts.title: Fubini’s theorem for integrable functions
concepts.description: An integrable function on the product of σ-finite measure spaces has integrable almost-everywhere sections, and its product integral equals either iterated integral.

concepts.title: Fundamental theorem of algebra
concepts.description: Every nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients has a complex root; equivalently it factors completely into linear factors over ℂ.

concepts.title: Density approximation for the weighted generalized-mean integrability criterion
concepts.description: Let (Λ,μ) be a nonzero σ-finite measure space and N≥2. Symmetric probability densities P on Λᴺ can be approximated in L¹ by strictly positive symmetric densities Q for which Q(·,x)≥γ(x)Q_(N−1) almost everywhere for almost every x in a positive-measure set, with γ(x)>0 and Q_(N−1) the marginal. If 0<μ(Λ)<∞, such densities contain an open dense subset of the bounded symmetric probability densities in the L∞ topology.

concepts.title: Generalized N-mean of a kernel of order m
concepts.description: For 1≤m≤N, set G_{m,N}(u)(x₁,…,x_N)=binom(N,m)⁻¹∑_{i₁<⋯<i_m}u(x_{i₁},…,x_{i_m}). Kernels need not be symmetric; equalities in measure-theoretic applications are understood almost everywhere.

concepts.title: Almost-everywhere convergence of generalized means and their kernels
concepts.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, fix 1≤m≤N. A sequence G_{m,N}(uₙ) has an almost-everywhere finite limit U exactly when uₙ has an almost-everywhere finite limit u; then U=G_{m,N}(u) almost everywhere. In particular a generalized mean has a unique kernel modulo null sets.

concepts.title: Measurability and essential boundedness in generalized-mean kernel recovery
concepts.description: On a nonzero complete σ-finite measure space, G_{m,N}(u) is measurable exactly when its almost-everywhere finite kernel u is measurable. Moreover G_{m,N}(u)∈L∞ exactly when u∈L∞, with ∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞≤∥u∥∞≤C(m,N)∥G_{m,N}(u)∥∞.

concepts.title: Weighted Lʳ equivalence for generalized means under a marginal lower bound
concepts.description: Let P>0 be a symmetric probability density on Λᴺ over a complete nonzero σ-finite measure space. Suppose on a positive-measure set of final coordinates x_N there is γ(x_N)>0 with P(·,x_N)≥γ(x_N)P_{N−1} almost everywhere. For 1≤m≤N and 1≤r<∞, G_{m,N}(u)∈Lʳ(P) exactly when u∈Lʳ(P_m), and the two norms are comparable by constants independent of u.
